story: Bea said, “I want to give Grandpa Len a cup.” The cup's handle was wide because Grandpa Len's hand was stiff. The shaping rib slipped, and the cup was dented. Mr Ivo said, “The cup's wall is thick.” Grandpa Len said, “I can hold a bowl with two hands.” Bea said, “I want a bowl.” Bea used the shaping rib to reshape the cup into a bowl. Mr Ivo fired the bowl twice. The bowl was cool. Bea gave Grandpa Len the bowl. Grandpa Len poured tea into the bowl. Grandpa Len held the bowl with two hands.
